question: Create a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy YAML that restricts egress from backend Pods to only TCP port 5432 in the database namespace.

ground_truth.answer:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-db-egress
  namespace: default
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: backend
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432
    to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: database
context: io.k8s.api.networking.v1.NetworkPolicy: defines traffic rules for Pods; spec is NetworkPolicySpec
io.k8s.api.networking.v1.NetworkPolicySpec: podSelector targets source Pods; policyTypes lists Ingress/Egress; egress is a list of NetworkPolicyEgressRule
io.k8s.api.networking.v1.NetworkPolicyEgressRule: ports (NetworkPolicyPort list) and to (NetworkPolicyPeer list with namespaceSelector/podSelector/ipBlock) define allowed egress
